ev_soildepth_inab_aa_def.quote:
AGROFORESTERÍA CON CULTIVOS ANUALES (Aa):
Areas con limitaciones de pendiente y/o profundidad efectiva del
suelo, donde se permite la siembra de cultivos agrícolas asocia-
dos con árboles y/o con obras de conservación de suelos y prác-
ticas o técnicas agronómicas de cultivo. (English: AGROFORESTRY WITH ANNUAL CROPS (Aa): Areas with limitations of slope and/or effective soil depth, where planting of agricultural crops associated with trees and/or soil conservation works and agronomic practices/techniques is permitted.)

ev_soildepth_inab_ap_def.quote:
AGROFORESTERÍA CON CULTIVOS PERMANENTES (Ap):
Areas con limitaciones de pendiente y profundidad, aptas para el
establecimiento de sistemas de cultivos permanentes asociados
con árboles (aislados, en bloques o plantaciones, ya sean espe-
cies frutales y otras con fines de producción de madera y otros
productos forestales). (English: AGROFORESTRY WITH PERMANENT CROPS (Ap): Areas with limitations of slope and depth, suitable for the establishment of permanent crop systems associated with trees (isolated, in blocks or plantations, whether fruit species and others for purposes of timber and other forest product production).)

Evidence → responses → compatible synthesis → developer table

  1. Read authoritative source and evidence registers. Keep dropped and unresolved records visible in evidence accounting; only eligible reviewed evidence sets compiled responses.
  2. Separate model use, suitability direction and numeric calibration. Species/crop scope, observed site conditions and operational feasibility keep their recorded roles.
  3. Convert units and standardize suitability classes using the versioned policy below. Preserve source ranks, gaps, overlaps and explicit unsuitable classes. Low suitability is not exclusion.
  4. Combine only profiles with approved matching pool, system, context, units and scoring policy. Deduplicate independent origins before weighting. At each interval, take the quality-weighted median; tied median bounds, within-origin conflicts and exclusion disagreements remain unknown.
  5. Rebuild from the full corpus and compare with audited T4. Dataset binding and target transfer are separate decisions. Publish function options and provenance, never an implicit universal choice.

Variable importance and spatial MCDA

Source weights are normalized within each complete sibling group, then multiplied along the source hierarchy to obtain whole-model shares. Additive repeat branches are consolidated by variable and scope. Flat ratio = whole-model share × number of distinct variable/scope inputs. Hierarchy-adjusted ratio = whole-model share ÷ equal-share contribution through the same tree. Missing or conflicting models retain holds; these diagnostics do not set runtime weights.

Choose one representative per thematic/correlation group before final weights. Current numerical baseline is weighted linear combination with separate gates. Final selected weights sum to one; missing inputs remain unknown, without per-pixel renormalization. Aggregation choice remains explicit because the original minimum-factor design differs.

Repairing incomplete curves

Verified continuations of reviewed source tables can be restored under an explicit, content-pinned correction policy. Source pages and agent verification remain visible; human approval flags and reviewed-study counts do not change. This does not create an independent study vote. A highest reported class below 1 is not automatically a missing class: high maps to 0.75 and very high to 0.9 under the common convention. Unknown thresholds and contradictory classes remain explicit.

Country and version rules

Target country selects dataset bindings. An optional exact study-country filter narrows evidence and recomputes compatible pools; neither approves transfer. This view uses the full corpus. Published developer bundles are pinned snapshots; this dashboard is the single inspection surface. Review decisions stay in QA/QC.
